headline: Small S swell but glassy at dawn — early log or nothing.
today: A bit over a foot on a fair angle, saved only by near-calm NW wind in the morning that leaves it glassy. Surf it early on a log before the S onshore comes up in the afternoon. Small and short, but clean while it lasts.

daysToWatch.note: SSW onshore climbs to 19mph through the day. Mushy and blown, skip it.
The week's headline — swell filling toward 4ft with N offshore in the morning. Short period so not classic, but the size and wind line up. Get on it early, shortboard or fish.
Still 1.7-2.4ft with NNE offshore at dawn and light morning wind. Clean leftovers worth an early session before the afternoon onshore.
